core_findings: BMA does not uniformly dominate single-model hard selection across three frozen true Bernoulli data generating rates.
Tie-breaking hard selection at train K=2 toward q=1/4 yields an asymmetric future risk under true p=1/4 versus p=3/4.
Truth oracle depends on unavailable ground-truth p; two-bit heldout Brier is only evaluated marginally.
limits: Only artificial exact finite Bernoulli worlds.
No prospective deployment, model uncertainty beyond the specified two candidate points, or true external population testing.
